// CASE dart_top_const_vs_body_field expect=pass
const width = 1;
class Importer {
  final int width = 4;
  Future<void> run(List<int> items) => mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save);
}
// CASE dart_top_const_vs_late_field expect=pass
const limit = 1;
class Exporter {
  Exporter(int value) : limit = value;
  final int limit;
  Future<void> run(List<int> items) => mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, save);
}
// CASE dart_top_const_vs_getter expect=pass
const concurrency = 1;
class Pool {
  int get concurrency => 4;
  Future<void> run(List<int> items) => mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, save);
}
// CASE dart_local_final_vs_closure_param expect=pass
Future<void> closureParam(List<List<int>> groups, List<int> widths) async {
  final width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  await Future.wait(widths.map((width) => mapWithConcurrency(groups.first, width, save)));
}
// CASE end expect=pass
